items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: And I was playing with the band. Well at that time he had kind of lost his health. He got so sick and weak I would say that I was mostly holding him up letting him you know try to make a piece of bread because I was playing sax.

ctx.x: Well I played with Buddy there. I had been playing in the band. We had been getting a whole lot of work over the lake around Madisonville and Maddenville all over there. He came from over there around Maddenville. Somewhere over there. And he was well known. People liked him you know. And I was playing with the band. Well at that time he had kind of lost his health. He got so sick and weak I would say that I was mostly holding him up letting him you know try to make a piece of bread because I was playing sax. And…
What was he sick of? Was there any particular sickness that he had?
